Dog Cargo Liner

You'll love our 4Knines Premium Dog Cargo Liner for SUVs or vans. It's safe for your pet and your car will stay clean.

  • HEAVY-DUTY - Colorfast and free of AZO dyes and heavy metals like lead, arsenic, or mercury. (**Not recommended for aggressively destructive dogs, i.e., this is not chew proof. Please do not leave your pet in your vehicle unsupervised**)
  • K9-SHIELD® WATERPROOF, NON-SLIP LAYER - Special non-quilted waterproof laminate layer makes the cargo liner completely waterproof while the non-slip backing keeps the cover from moving around (seams are not watertight). K9-SHIELD is a special textile laminate developed by 4Knines to provide maximum protection for your vehicle.
  • EASY TO CLEAN - Hose it down, wipe down with a moist towel, or toss it in the washer to keep it looking fresh and clean.

Looking for more convenience features like armrest pass through access or fold down seat compatible? Check out our Split Cargo Liner here.

4Knines is committed to giving back to the animal community.
We donate a percentage of each sale to animal advocacy groups.
